payout_quote: You can tap the 'Cash Out Now' button in Gig History to receive your payment immediately. A $1.99 processing fee will be deducted from your balance, and you'll receive your payment within minutes (depending on your bank).
timing: On demand via Cash Out Now in Gig History; payment within minutes depending on bank. Unused earnings are deposited weekly on Wednesday mornings.
eligibility: Roadie driver whose first Gig was completed more than 7 days ago with at least 5 total Gigs; valid debit card added in Bank Info (1-day security waiting period after adding).
steps: Complete your first Gig more than 7 days ago and at least 5 Gigs total since signup.
Add a valid debit card in the Bank Info section of the Roadie app and wait the 1-day security period.
Open Gig History and tap Cash Out Now to receive payment immediately ($1.99 deducted).
Leave the balance alone to receive the free weekly deposit on Wednesday mornings instead.

who_pays: Roadie pays your gig earnings, and Cash Out Now in Gig History sends them to the debit card you added in Bank Info. Leave the balance alone and Roadie deposits it free every Wednesday morning.
who_qualifies: You need a Roadie driver account whose first gig was completed more than 7 days ago, at least 5 gigs total, and a valid debit card in Bank Info (with a 1-day security wait after adding it). Roadie's official requirements also cover being 18 or older, holding a valid US driver's license and Social Security number, consenting to a background screening, and carrying auto insurance that covers gig work.
work_available: Gigs depend on what senders post in your area - drivers claim open gigs, so slow markets can mean few gigs to pick from. The official page promises no minimum gig volume; how much you can earn depends on what is posted near you.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid for gigs you complete and confirm in the app; canceled or incomplete gigs do not pay. Some driver guides report Roadie expects drivers to hold a 4-star rating to stay active, but the official cashout article publishes no exact rating threshold for withheld pay - that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Each Instant Pay cashout costs $1.99, deducted from your balance, with no free same-day option. Fuel, maintenance, insurance, and tolls all come out of your pocket, and time spent waiting for gigs, driving unpaid to pickups, and onboarding is unpaid: only completed gigs pay.
when_cash_arrives: Tap Cash Out Now in Gig History and your full balance arrives within minutes, depending on your bank, minus $1.99 per cashout. Anything you leave untouched deposits free on Wednesday mornings.
